## file: Gamma_dist.R
gamma_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  
  #layout_sidebar(
  div(
    style = "margin-bottom: 80px;",
    
    fluidRow(
      # control on the left 
      column(
        width = 4,
        
        # add scale/rate choices
        radioButtons(
          ns("parameterization"),
          "Parameterization",
          choices = c(
            "Shape, Scale" = "scale",
            "Shape, Rate" = "rate"
          ),
          selected = "scale"
        ),
        
        sliderInput(
          ns("shape"), "Shape",
          min = 0.1, max = 20,
          value = 1, step = 0.1
        ),
        
        sliderInput(
          ns("second"), "Scale", # internally named as second
          min = 0.1, max = 10,
          value = 3, step = 0.1
        ),
        
        actionButton(
          ns("simulate"),
          "Generate new draw"
        )
      ),
      
      # plot on the right 
      column(
        width = 8, 
        plotOutput(ns("gamma_plot"), height = "400px", width = "600px")
      )
    )
  )
}


gamma_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    # add an obs event for the param choices 
    observeEvent(input$parameterization,{
      req(input$second) 
      
      updateSliderInput(
        session, 
        "second",
        label = if(input$parameterization == "scale"){
          "Scale"
        } else{
          "Rate"
        },
        value = 1/input$second
      )
    }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
    
    # save the samples and param together 
    simulation <- eventReactive(
      input$simulate,{
        req(input$shape, input$second)
        shape = input$shape
        
        # use scale internally, regardless the selected option
        scale = if(input$parameterization == "scale"){
          input$second
        } else{
          1/input$second
        }
        
        list(
          shape = shape, 
          scale = scale, 
          choice = input$parameterization, 
          second = input$second, 
          draws = rgamma(1000, shape = shape, scale = scale)
        )
      }, ignoreNULL = FALSE)
    
    output$gamma_plot <- renderPlot({
      sim <- simulation()
      
      # Use a common horizontal range for both plots
      xmax <- max(
        sim$draws,
        qgamma(0.995, shape = sim$shape, scale = sim$scale)
      )
      
      # Avoid evaluating the PDF at zero when shape < 1
      x <- seq(xmax / 10000, xmax, length.out = 2000)
      
      # set plot layout
      old_par <- par(
        mfrow = c(2, 1),
        mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1)
      )
      on.exit(par(old_par))
      
      # make a histogram 
      par(font.main = 1) #fix plot title issue on netlify
      
      hist(
        sim$draws,
        breaks = 30,
        probability = TRUE,
        col = "#BCD4E6",
        border = "white",
        xlab = "x",
        ylab = "Density",
        main = paste(
          "Gamma: shape =", sim$shape,
          ", scale =", sim$scale
        )
      )
      
      lines(
        x,
        dgamma(x, shape = sim$shape, scale = sim$scale),
        col = "#C0392B",
        lwd = 2
      )
      
      # 2. Theoretical cumulative distribution function
      x_cdf <- c(0, x)
      
      plot(
        x_cdf,
        pgamma(x_cdf, shape = sim$shape, scale = sim$scale),
        type = "l",
        col = "#4472C4",
        lwd = 2,
        xlim = c(0, xmax),
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        xlab = "x",
        ylab = "P(X ≤ x)",
        main = "Cumulative distribution function"
      )
    })
  })
}
## file: beta_dist.R
# simulate and visualise beta distribution 

beta_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  
  div(
    style = "margin-bottom: 80px;",
    
    fluidRow(
      # control on the left 
      column(
        width = 4,
        
          sliderInput(
            ns("alpha"), "alpha",
            min = 0.1, max = 20,
            value = 1, step = 0.1
          ),
          
          sliderInput(
            ns("beta"), "beta",
            min = 0.1, max = 10,
            value = 3, step = 0.1
          ),
          
          actionButton(
            ns("simulate"),
            "Generate new draw"
          )
      ),
      
      # plot on the right 
      column(width = 8, 
        plotOutput(ns("beta_plot"), height = "400px", width = "600px")
      )
    )
  )
}


beta_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    simulation <- eventReactive(
      input$simulate,
      {
        # Store the parameters alongside their generated sample
        alpha <- input$alpha
        beta <- input$beta
        
        list(
          draws = rbeta(500, alpha, beta),
          alpha = alpha,
          beta = beta
        )
      },
      ignoreNULL = FALSE
    )
    
    output$beta_plot <- renderPlot({
      sim <- simulation()
      
      par(font.main = 1)
      
      hist(
        sim$draws,
        breaks = 30,
        probability = TRUE,
        col = "#BCD4E6",
        border = "white",
        xlab = "x",
        ylab = "Density",
        main = paste(
          "Beta: Alpha =", sim$alpha,
          ", Beta =", sim$beta
        )
      )
      
      # Start above zero: the density diverges at zero if shape < 1
      x <- seq(
        max(sim$draws) * 1e-6,
        max(sim$draws),
        length.out = 1000
      )
      
      lines(
        x,
        dbeta(x, sim$alpha, sim$beta),
        col = "#C0392B",
        lwd = 2
      )
    })
  })
}
## file: dirichlet_distribution.R
# simulate and visualise Dirichlet distribution 

dirichlet_ui <- function(id) {
  ns <- NS(id)
  
  div(
    style = "margin-bottom: 80px;",
    
    fluidRow(
      # control on the left 
      column(width = 4,
          sliderInput(
            ns("alpha"),
            "Concentration parameter",
            min = 0.01,
            max = 20,
            value = 1,
            step = 0.01
          ),
      
          sliderInput(
            ns("n_components"),
            "Number of components",
            min = 2,
            max = 10,
            value = 3
          ),
      
          actionButton(
            ns("simulate"),
            "Generate new draw"
          )
    ),
    
    column(width = 8,
      plotOutput(ns("weights_plot"), height = "400px", width = "600px")
    )
  )
)
}


dirichlet_server <- function(id) {
  moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
    
    weights <- eventReactive(
      input$simulate,
      {
        gamma_draws <- rgamma(
          n = input$n_components,
          shape = input$alpha,
          rate = 1
        )
        
        gamma_draws / sum(gamma_draws)
      },
      ignoreNULL = FALSE
    )
    
    par(font.main = 1)
    
    output$weights_plot <- renderPlot({
      barplot(
        weights(),
        names.arg = paste0("Component ", seq_along(weights())),
        ylim = c(0, 1),
        col = "#4472C4",
        border = NA,
        xlab = "Component",
        ylab = "Weight"
       # main = paste("Alpha =", input$alpha)
      )
      
      abline(
        h = 1 / input$n_components,
        col = "red",
        lty = 2
      )
    })
  })
}

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)

# call files for each topic 
source("Gamma_dist.R")
source("beta_dist.R")
source("dirichlet_distribution.R")

ui = page_fluid(
    h2("Distribution Playground"),
    
    h3("Gamma distribution"),
    gamma_ui("gamma"),
    
    hr(),
    
    h3("Beta distribution"),
    beta_ui("beta"),
    
    hr(),
    
    h3("Dirichlet distribution"),
    dirichlet_ui("dirichlet"), 
  theme = bs_theme(
    preset = "flatly"
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  gamma_server("gamma")
  dirichlet_server("dirichlet")
  beta_server("beta")
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
